details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19844-19853 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The standalone stall-loop skip list (around line 19852) does not include `ai:claude-capacity-wait`, so a standalone issue with the label is retriggered (`/reclarify` via `retrigger_pipeline`).
  WHY: This contradicts the README, changelog and agents fragment, which say stall recovery leaves the item alone; only the Python `detect_stalls` path was updated and tested. Reviewers rated it MAJOR (qwen_qwen3_7-plus in its task-gap form). It is latent while the switch is off.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:230-285 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `report_capacity_wait` applies the `ai:claude-capacity-wait` label before the tracker helper check, tracker open and tracker marker post. A tracker failure only warns and leaves the item labelled with no tracker marker.
  WHY: The resume pass finds waiting work through tracker markers, so the item is stranded. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT and the others MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:187 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `run_token="${RUN_ID}"` reads an unset `RUN_ID` instead of `GITHUB_RUN_ID`, so markers carry `run=none`.
  WHY: Markers and tracker comments would lose the real run id. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say line 77 sets `RUN_ID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"`, so this is a false positive.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:257-284 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the tracker lookup or open fails, `tracker` is `none` and the Telegram WARNING reads "tracker #none". The agents fragment says the alert is sent only when the call opened the tracker, which is not exact.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell that tracker creation failed.
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1523-1672 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `security_audit_try_claude` has no branch for exit 80. The `all_gated` path returns 1 (run codex), and `claude_rc` 80 falls into the `*` arm, is refused (76) and fails closed.
  WHY: With `CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED=true` the security audit falls back to codex or fails closed, breaking the "wait, do not fall back" contract.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:228 and scripts/provider_outage.py:130 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Python trims whitespace with `.strip()` and bash does not, so `"true "` is on in Python and off in bash. The tracker text can then say work is waiting while codex still runs.
  WHY: The two views of the switch diverge. minimax_minimax-m3 rated this MAJOR in its main findings; the other three listed it only as a hardening suggestion (risk 1). The highest is used.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:198-203 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Item metadata defaults to `kind=run`, and no workflow or template sets `CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT_ITEM_KIND` or `CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT_ITEM_NUMBER`.
  WHY: Real phase jobs record run-scoped waits and never label the issue or PR, so the poller cannot hold stall recovery. The tests pass only because they supply the variables directly.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:230-285 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wait reporter's label, comments, tracker open and Telegram alert have no per-job opt-out. Only the global `CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED` flag turns them off, and it also disables the wait semantic.
  WHY: A stale item number could label or comment on the wrong issue, and the coupling to the global flag is undocumented.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:197 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `tracker_marker="skipped"` initialisation (and the other state defaults on line 197) is dead or unreachable.
  WHY: Both branches overwrite the value, and the agents fragment log vocabulary documents `skipped`. Reported as a hardening suggestion only (risk 1).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Phase 1 test row: "`tests/test_review_sandbox_claude_roles.py` and the `clarify_isolated_run.sh` tests: the same mapping" (exit 80 never remapped to 75 or 1)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_sandbox_claude_roles.py (`test_claude_branch_passes_the_capacity_wait_exit_through`) and the `clarify_isolated_run.sh` tests
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The new test only checks source substrings and never runs `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh` or `clarify_isolated_run.sh`, so a regression remapping exit 80 would still pass. `tests/test_ai_engine.py` does run `claude_run` and `claude_run_selected` to exit 80.
- requirement: The agents fragment and README say "stall recovery leaves the item alone" for `ai:claude-capacity-wait`
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19852 (standalone stall loop skip list)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches line 19852 and the file is outside the `files_touched` grant. `test_detect_stalls_skips_capacity_wait_phase` only covers the Python `detect_stalls` path.
- requirement: The Phase 1 wait semantic: do not run codex, do not fail closed, return exit 80, and surface the wait. All `claude_run` and `ai_engine_fallback` consumers must coordinate.
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh::security_audit_try_claude (lines 1523-1672)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk adds an `80)` arm to the `claude_rc` case or changes the `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_EXIT == 76` checks. `scripts/security_audit.sh` is not in `files_touched`, and no test covers the security audit's 80 path.
- requirement: "Then implement the activation gaps as the plans' ordered, independently mergeable phase PRs."
  expected_change_site: The ordered activation-plan phases (the `Activation Gates (human)` plan section and lint, planning-prompt changes, dependency-wait resume work)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff implements only Claude capacity-wait Phase 1 and contains none of the other activation-plan deliverables.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19852 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone stall-loop skip list lacks `ai:claude-capacity-wait`, so a standalone item with the label gets a recovery action (a `/reclarify` retrigger).
  WHY: The documented behavior holds only for the Python `detect_stalls` path. It is latent while `CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED` is off.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:`report_capacity_wait` label add before tracker work | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label is added before the tracker helper check, comment read and marker post. A failure only warns and keeps the label.
  WHY: Stall recovery skips the item while the tracker has no marker, so the item is parked with no recorded wait.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:`tg_send_msg` call in `report_capacity_wait` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `provider_outage.py` writes the alert file even when the tracker lookup failed, so the alert reads "tracker #none". The agents fragment's "only when opened" claim is not exact.
  WHY: The alert hides that tracker creation failed.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Phase 1 test row "`tests/test_review_sandbox_claude_roles.py` and the `clarify_isolated_run.sh` tests: the same mapping"; Expected change site: `tests/test_review_sandbox_claude_roles.py`; Evidence of absence: the test only checks source substrings and never runs either script, while `tests/test_ai_engine.py` covers the core mapping | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- Hardening: `scripts/provider_outage.py` (`_capacity_wait_enabled`) vs `scripts/ai_engine.sh` (`ai_engine_capacity_wait_enabled`) differ on whitespace trimming; trim in bash or drop `.strip()`.
- Hardening: print `tracker unavailable` instead of "tracker #none" in `report_capacity_wait`.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Dropped pass-1 finding: the unset `RUN_ID` claim is wrong, because line 77 sets `RUN_ID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: If the tracker marker post fails, the issue stays labelled "waiting" but the resume pass never finds it.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:around 274 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When tracker creation fails, the Telegram message reports tracker #none.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish a successful tracker from a system-level failure.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Phase 1 test row "`tests/test_review_sandbox_claude_roles.py` and the `clarify_isolated_run.sh` tests: the same mapping"; Expected change site: tests/test_review_sandbox_claude_roles.py and the clarify_isolated_run.sh tests; Evidence of absence: the tests check only source substrings and never execute the scripts | severity=NIT | confidence=3
